meaning: Measured average feed-in profile of Dutch connections that export, as fractions of the annual exported volume.
source: NEDU standaardprofielen elektriciteit 2025 v1.00, via Energiedatawijzer
note: Aggregate shares derived from the series, not the series itself: twelve monthly and twenty four hourly figures rather than 35040 values. Enough to calibrate the shape of a modelled export profile, and small enough that it is a fact about the dataset rather than a copy of it, which matters while the redistribution terms are unconfirmed.
